modalities.evidence: associated ECG signals used for determination of reference HR
single-value annotations of blood pressure, blood oxygen saturation and glycaemia

output.population: 50 subjects (25 female, 25 male) aged between 19 to 76 years at rest and during various types of movement
output.summary: Smartphone-recorded photoplethysmography signals with simultaneous reference ECG and accelerometer data, collected at rest and during movement, annotated for signal quality and reference heart rate to support quality assessment and heart rate estimation.
